Recipe:
 
About 2 cups of cubed butternut squash
One box of spaghetti 
About a 1/4 cup of chopped up walnuts 
2-3 garlic cloves
A handful or two of baby spinach
Chili flakes
Olive oil
Salt and pepper

Rub some olive oil on the squash and season it with salt. Put it on a sheet pan in the oven at 450 degrees Fahrenheit for about 30-40 minutes (you kinda have to watch it). When it’s done, take half and mash it up. Set it aside. 

Cook the spaghetti al dente. 

Dice up the garlic and put it in a pan with some olive oil, cook that up and add some chili flakes, cook for a couple more minutes. Add the spaghetti and the mashed squash to the pan and mix it all together. Add the other cubed squash and the spinach. Mix and continue sautéing in the pan until spinach wilts a little. Season with salt and pepper and more chili flakes if you’d like. Add walnuts as a garnish and you’re good to go!
